limitations.description: Release 4 remains metadata-bound and immutable. FMDL-4C cannot reconcile existing symbol membership inside candidate, simulation or real-account files without readable base ZIP bytes.
The six accepted transitions create a new versioned re-entry review queue only. They do not admit a symbol to the existing candidate pool, simulation or real account.
Current entry price, portfolio fit, RCM, ETF alternative, capital migration and user-confirmation gates remain downstream requirements.
